ui_bugs.issue: FIXED. Save/Clear success path called setMsg with an axios Response object (truthy) instead of a string, causing React error #31 ('Objects are not valid as a React child { data, status, statusText, headers, config, request }') and blanking the whole Master Data & Audit screen. Root cause: act(fn, ok) does `setMsg(m || ok)` where m is the resolved Response for PUT /admin/integrations. Applied fix: coerce m to string with typeof check + safer error coercion for setErr.

action_items: Review the OpenAiIntegrationPanel.jsx fix (line 16). The original code `setMsg(m || ok)` was passing an axios Response object as React child. Consider making save/clear helpers return the ok string explicitly at the axios level (e.g. axios.put(...).then(() => 'Kunci tersimpan…')) instead of relying on defensive typeof checks in the reducer — but the current defensive coercion is safe.
Optional: The demo GRN KSC/GRN-00001 was moved from 'Tinjau SJ' to 'Hitung fisik' by the pick+start-count test (as noted acceptable in review). No cleanup performed.

Two leftover Draf GRNs created for OCR banner tests remain in ent_ksc: KSC/GRN-00002 (Cirebon Craft, OCR-populated via mock — DN SJ-MOCK-CLEAR, 1+1 lines) and KSC/GRN-00003 (Cirebon Craft, OCR_AUTH failed — empty DN). Non-blocking; can be cancelled in a future cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: OpenAiIntegrationPanel.jsx: `act(fn, ok)` reducer was rendering axios Response objects into JSX. Fixed with typeof-guard for setMsg and JSON.stringify fallback for setErr when detail is not a string. Root cause is a common trap when a mutation helper's fn returns the raw axios promise result — always resolve to a string or void before setState.

goods_receipt_service.public_view: `ocr_enabled` boolean is only present on the detail response (verified via curl on grn_c0c4695b2663 → false). The list endpoint does NOT include ocr_enabled (returns null in list). Spec only requires it on GET /{id}, so this is fine, but noting the asymmetry.

grn-ocr-progress banner is too short-lived to observe with mock fixtures (returns synchronously in <100ms). This is a test-observability gap — consider a small artificial delay in the mock adapter or a persistent 'last read' indicator so the progress state is provable in E2E tests. Baca otomatis Real-model path would trip this, but no key configured.

rca of the issue: Bug: clicking 'Simpan Kunci' in Admin → Integrasi AI → OpenAI panel crashed the entire Master Data & Audit route with React error #31. RCA: OpenAiIntegrationPanel.jsx `act` helper resolved the raw axios PUT Response object and passed it into `setMsg`, then rendered {msg} into JSX — React can't render plain objects. Reproduction: as admin@, ?view=admin, Master Data & Audit tab → Integrasi AI sub-tab → fill any string in openai-apikey → click openai-save → panel replaced with red 'Layar ini gagal ditampilkan' fallback and console shows minified error #31. Mitigation applied: `setMsg(typeof m === 'string' && m ? m : ok)` and defensive `setErr` coercion for non-string detail. Verified fix: after `yarn build` + restart, Save → status 'KEY TERSIMPAN, BELUM DIUJI', openai-test + openai-clear render, no crash.
